confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors rest on dated, crowdsourced or single-source Udaipur price points (cost-of-living and price-comparison sites, a 2024 Expatistan average, and undated or unconfirmed menus), so they are approximate. Cocktail uses the Expatistan downtown-club average (about 7x the beer figure, a 2024 crowd estimate with few data points) and is likely low for hotel bars. Wine uses a Rajasthan-unconfirmed menu, cross-checked at about 3x beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context, not checked against live listings; the 3-star anchor is the most uncertain given seasonal and palace-hotel pricing. FX is the RBA 4.00 pm AUD/USD rate for 15 October 2026 as reported on the RBA Exchange Rates Overview; I could not fetch that page directly, and the 16 October figure was not confirmed on rba.gov.au.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are Udaipur-specific where data exists (cost-of-living and price-comparison figures for meals, cappuccino and beer), with a tourist-area uplift for mid-range meals. Cocktail and wine are set from the local price relationship to beer, since direct Udaipur data is weak. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a major Rajasthan tourist city, with peak-season and lake-view hotel pricing above the typical level.
